subject: Request: Additional discount for BrightOak Health — forecast treatment

From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@brightoakhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 08:14:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Additional discount for BrightOak Health — forecast treatment

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement has one final ask: to get procurement committee sign-off this quarter they need an additional concession on the SOW pricing — roughly 12% off list. BrightOak is targeting a Dec 1 start for the pilot and the CFO has said this needs to be reflected in our supplier proposal to make the Q4 spend plan.

Before I go to the committee we need written confirmation from Redwood on two items:
- Whether you can approve a 12% off standard pricing (or provide the max allowed without higher approval)
- How Redwood will treat the line in its forecast if we move forward (i.e., will Sales mark as committed / count toward Q4 ARR or is it considered at-risk until DocuSign executed?)

Can you confirm next steps and timeline? We are under a hard vendor selection window next week.

Attachments: BrightOak_SOW_v2.pdf (redlined v2)

Best,
Lena Ortiz
Head of Procurement
BrightOak Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Request: Additional discount for BrightOak Health — forecast treatment

Thanks, Lena — appreciate the clarity and the deadline context.

Quick summary / next steps from Redwood:
1) I will route this to Deal Desk (cc'd Rishi) for a formal sanction. Please consider this the official request for a 12% concession. I have attached the redlined SOW you sent and a working discount matrix we will use internally.
2) Deal Desk will provide an approval in principle or an alternate concession floor within 24-48 hours.
3) Finance (cc'd Vanessa) will confirm how to treat the amount in the Q4 forecast — my expectation is we should mark as "Verbal Commit — Pending Deal Desk" in HubSpot until final Deal Desk sign-off and DocuSign, and Finance may want a reserve against the forecast if the concession exceeds policy.

Please confirm you are okay with Dec 1 as the proposed pilot/contract effective date so we can pass that through Deal Desk and Finance. If you can, also confirm whether purchase order or a signed SOW is the procurement committee's preferred instrument.

Attachments: BrightOak_SOW_v2.pdf, discount_matrix.xlsx

Best,
Marissa Cole

Marissa / Lena — thanks for the heads-up. Deal Desk has reviewed the redlined SOW and the concession ask. Preliminary position: we can sanction up to 12% as an exception, subject to the following conditions being satisfied before finance books any portion into committed revenue:
- Legal sign-off on SOW redlines (no open indemnity/data terms)
- Finance confirmation on reserve/recognition treatment (cc Vanessa)
- Execution via DocuSign (no manual POs only)

If conditions above are met, Deal Desk will issue a sanction code: DD-12-BRHT and approve moving the opportunity to a forecasted committed state for internal reporting, but Finance must confirm whether any of the value should remain as "At-Risk" until funds are received.

I will update the Deal Desk ticket and post the formal sanction memo within 24 hours. Marissa, please confirm the final list price, discounted ARR and expected term length so we can capture exact numbers in the memo.

-Rishi

Team — Finance position / requirements:
1) Any concession >10% requires a one-time reserve against Q4 forecast (deal reserve) until cash or signed DocuSign is received. We will quantify the reserve amount once Marissa provides the final discounted ARR and start date.
2) For accounting we need the following before recognizing any revenue: completed DocuSign executed copy, final SOW with effective date, and confirmation of billing cadence (annual vs monthly).
3) Please include the GL code for deferred revenue in the Deal Desk memo; if RevOps needs help with mapping I'll loop Ben.

Action items for Marissa: please confirm final numbers (list vs discounted ARR), term length, and whether BrightOak will issue a PO or prefers the DocuSign-signed SOW. Once those are in I'll provide the recommended reserve amount and recognition guidance.
